# Single-card message for the builder (careful lane, and any card built alone)

Claude fills in the card ID, makes the builder's copy (`git worktree add ../ytp-work/TASK-XXXX -b task/TASK-XXXX main`) and gives the owner the finished message to paste; nothing is left to fill in. Batches of fast cards use `docs/templates/BATCH-PROMPT.md` instead.

```
You are the builder for task card TASK-XXXX in the YTP Nexus project. This folder is your own copy of the project: a git worktree on the branch task/TASK-XXXX (it is already made, so skip the card's "Make your own copy" line). Before anything else, even before pnpm install, create your log docs/logs/TASK-XXXX.md from docs/templates/TASK-LOG.md and write in it the line `- Start point (commit): <hash>` with the bare hash from `git rev-parse HEAD`, with no backticks, bold or words after it; the start check's Allowed files step must then pass. Leave every other field of the log empty until what it records has happened: the start-check answers after both start-check runs, Files changed after the files exist, Result and Attempts after the final verify.
1. Read AGENTS.md completely and follow it exactly.
2. Then do docs/tasks/TASK-XXXX.md exactly: BEFORE YOU START, every STEP in order, VERIFY AND DEBUG, then WHEN GREEN.
3. Touch only the files in the card's ALLOWED FILES table, plus your log (docs/logs/TASK-XXXX.md), your evidence folder (docs/evidence/TASK-XXXX/) and the TASK-XXXX lines in docs/STATUS.md and docs/tasks/INDEX.md.
4. Never edit any test file or tests/LOCK. If anything is unclear, stop, write the question in your log under "If BLOCKED" (never in docs/QUESTIONS.md) and mark the card BLOCKED.
5. Write the start-point line in your log before the start check, and set Done in docs/STATUS.md and docs/tasks/INDEX.md only after the final verify passes. In the log, list every command exactly as typed (including the one that saved the evidence file, which is one of the two save commands in docs/templates/TASK-LOG.md) and paste the real output of both start-check runs and the final run, never a summary you wrote. The run you save as evidence is your final verify run: after it, run no further verify; only take the screenshots and run the commands the card says to do after the final verify (they change no file), write your log, set Done, rebuild the tracker and commit (AGENTS.md section 3, step 6), and stop any server you started; if you change any other file after it, save the evidence again with the same command. Run pnpm install first, and pnpm format before verifying. Never write a real password, key or token into any file. Your copy has infra/.env and infra/.env.test (Claude put them there): never print, copy or change them; from TASK-0014 on every card needs them: if one is missing, stop and mark the card BLOCKED. From TASK-0014 on, start Docker Desktop and run pnpm services:up before the start check. Paste every output whole, never shortened with "..." (save a long one with the template's save command and paste that file). List the git add and git commit lines too, and every other command you ran, in order: failed and repeated runs, port and process checks and read-only commands such as git status and git grep included, each exactly as you typed it, with no wrapper added. Never stop a process you did not start, even one the owner told you to stop before: if a port is busy, stop and tell the owner which program holds it, and wait. Type the evidence save command exactly as one of the template's two lines, never wrapped in another shell. Make the one commit the card asks for, with the commit text copied exactly from WHEN GREEN. Do not push to GitHub.
6. Finish with the reply described in AGENTS.md section 5.
```
